adminServices.eggChangeClearsEnvironment: Saving a different Egg removes stored environment values. Configure them again for the new definition.
adminServices.environmentNote: Stored values are encrypted and are never returned to this form. Untouched empty fields retain existing values. Use the separate button to remove a value.
adminServices.valueWillBeRemoved: The value will be removed when saved.
adminServices.manualEggUpdates: The service keeps its pinned version. Updating requires an explicit decision; running services are never changed automatically.

installationBlockers.MINECRAFT_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: Choose a Minecraft version, reserve a port and accept the EULA in Minecraft configuration.
installationBlockers.AGENT_MINECRAFT_UNAVAILABLE: The node agent needs a version supporting Minecraft installation.
installationBlockers.MINECRAFT_FILES_REQUIRED: Minecraft server files are missing. Check service installation.
installationBlockers.MINECRAFT_PORT_INVALID: The internal port in server.properties must be 25565. The public port is allocated separately.
installationBlockers.APPLICATION_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Choose an application from the catalog and save its profile.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_FILES_REQUIRED: Upload project files. A Git repository is not required in own-files mode.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_PACKAGE_REQUIRED: Upload package.json at the root of the Node.js project.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_PACKAGE_INVALID: Fix package.json: it must be a valid JSON object no larger than 64 KiB.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_START_SCRIPT_REQUIRED: Add scripts.start to package.json or choose a profile that starts a specific file.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_ENTRYPOINT_REQUIRED: Upload the entrypoint required by the selected Egg profile.
installationBlockers.PROJECT_FILES_UNAVAILABLE: Project files could not be read or verified. Check them before installation.
installationBlockers.AGENT_FILE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Update the Agent to a version supporting installation from uploaded files.
installationBlockers.PANEL_INSTALL_DISPATCH_UNAVAILABLE: The service installation queue still requires Agent executor integration. Configuration and Egg imports are available independently.
installationBlockers.EGG_UNAVAILABLE: The Egg must be enabled in an enabled repository.
installationBlockers.AGENT_INSTALL_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE: The connected Agent does not advertise all capabilities required by the selected Egg. Check the node Agent version and configuration.
installationBlockers.PUBLIC_GIT_PROJECT_REQUIRED: Git source selected: enter a public repository and save configuration. If you upload files yourself, select Own files instead.
installationBlockers.INVALID_RESOURCE_LIMITS: Set RAM to at least 128 MB, CPU to 1–100%, and a disk limit.
installationBlockers.AGENT_PACKAGE_MANAGER_UNAVAILABLE: The selected application requires pnpm. Update the node Agent to a version advertising pnpm support.
installationBlockers.AGENT_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE: The agent cannot currently provide service files or status. Check its connection and version.
installationBlockers.AGENT_STEAM_UNAVAILABLE: The agent requires SteamCMD Valheim support.
installationBlockers.VALHEIM_RESOURCES_REQUIRED: Valheim requires at least 4096 MiB RAM and 10240 MiB disk.
installationBlockers.VALHEIM_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Enter a valid server name, world name and Valheim password (5–64 characters).
installationBlockers.STEAM_PORT_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE: No two consecutive UDP ports are available in the node pool.
installationBlockers.STEAM_PORT_ALLOCATION_INVALID: The Valheim port allocation does not match the service node.
installationBlockers.VALHEIM_BINARY_REQUIRED: The Valheim server binary is missing. Check the SteamCMD installation result.
